findings.now: All 36 ATC codes appear as outline chips, and each label cuts its description at 40 characters with no ellipsis.
findings.why: The official form lists 36 ATC checkboxes (AtcCode1 to AtcCode36 in 2550m-v2007.json), and a wall of 36 chips is harder to scan and search than that list.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: Search by code or full description, pick several ATCs, and add a sales row for each pick.

options.name: Checkbox list
options.detail: One checkbox per ATC with the full description, matching the official AtcCode checkboxes.

findings.now: The month is a row of 12 outline buttons (Jan to Dec).
findings.why: The official form uses a month select (frm2550m:RtnYear with '01 - January' and so on, BIR-Form2550M.hta:303), and 12 options are far past the 4-option limit for buttons.

options.name: Select dropdown
options.detail: A plain month select with the full month names, the same control the official form uses.

findings.now: The tile sets the month, but the buttons stay active; a changed month saves as a second draft while the tile keeps reopening the old one.
findings.why: new_draft takes the month from the tile (form_2550m_view.rs:1633-1640) and drafts are saved by period (the upsert select_row in db/queueable.rs:144-154), so a changed period creates a new row.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the tile's month as a chip; a different month means opening that month's own tile.

options.name: Combobox with warning
options.detail: Keep the month editable in a combobox and warn that saving moves the draft to the new month.

findings.now: Errors only turn labels red and list at the bottom under Needs review, and Queue for submission is disabled with no message beside it.
findings.why: The list sits after the last section and stops at 20 messages, so the blocking schedule is not visible from the button.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Show the official row alert text next to the schedule row it concerns.

options.name: Summary above the body
options.detail: Show the Needs review list above Part I with a link to each item.

findings.now: The 2550M upload commit also changes form_2552.rs (every 2552 schedule control value is upper-cased), the 2552 layout and the 2552 fixtures.
findings.why: Changing another form's upload output inside a 2550M commit goes beyond the form's own files and one-line registrations.

options.name: Split commit
options.detail: Land the 2552 change as its own commit with its fixtures and test.

options.name: Revert the 2552 part
options.detail: Keep the 2550M files in this commit and re-check 2552 separately.

findings.now: 28 schedule-row key templates (for example txtDescription{i}, txtAmountSales{n}, txtAtcCde{n}) are not in 2550m-v2007.json.
findings.why: They are inserted by anchor after write() (official_payload, form_2550m.rs:1853), so the UnknownKey guard in official_xml.rs:227-232 never checks them.

options.name: Extend the layout
options.detail: Generate the schedule-row keys into 2550m-v2007.json from a sample save that has rows.

options.name: Test against the HTA
options.detail: Assert that each row key appears as an element id in BIR-Form2550M.hta.

findings.now: A negative amount that rounds to zero displays and uploads as 0.00.
findings.why: formatCurrency (string-util.js:321-356) keeps the minus sign, but official_amount drops it when the cents round to zero (official_xml.rs:493-497), so uploaded bytes can differ.

options.name: Match formatCurrency
options.detail: Keep the minus sign for any negative input, as formatCurrency does.

options.name: Clamp in calculation
options.detail: Round tiny negatives to zero in the calculation and document the deviation.

findings.field: Email address for the BIR confirmation
findings.now: A blank or malformed email shows 'Enter the email address BIR sends the filing confirmation to.', which no official alert uses.
findings.why: The official HTA has no such text, so the filer sees wording eBIRForms never shows.

options.name: Keep as app note
options.detail: Keep the check but mark it as an app rule, not an official alert.

options.name: Remove
options.detail: Rely on the official alerts for the email field.
